findings.explanation: Your payment depends on the Client confirming the invoice and is deferred for 45 days after that confirmation, making payment conditional on an event the Client controls.
findings.suggested_change: The Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before proceeding, I have one adjustment to propose: - In the relevant clause, payment is conditional on confirmation and deferred for 45 days, which leaves payment dependent on an event controlled by the client; I propose modifying this so that the client shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty days of receipt. Thank you, and I look forward to finalizing this.
